newsitem.title: USA: Stark says cannot understand EMU market nerves.
newsitem.headline: Stark says cannot understand EMU market nerves.

text.p: Juergen Stark, state secretary in the Germany Finance Ministry, said he could not understand recent foreign exchange market jitters over a possible delay in the timetable for European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
"I do not understand this kind of nervousness. It is not caused by politicans. It is caused by the markets themselves," he said.
Stark was addressing an event in New York that was sponsored by the American Council on Germany.
EMU is targeted for launch in January 1999, but some countries have not yet made sufficient progress in reducing their deficits to meet the requirements for EMU entry.
